afk_adapter resolves its kind two subshells deep: afk_adapter calls $(afk_adapter_dir), which calls $(afk_adapter_kind), which runs afk_config_load (an early return once AFK_CFG_LOADED=1 is in the shell, else an eval of afk-config.py export-shell from the cwd) and reads AFK_CFG_<FAMILY>; an empty kind or a missing kind folder exits 2.

The code callers of afk_adapter are skills/afk/gc/scripts/gc-check.sh:136 and skills/afk/review/scripts/forge_ledger.py:760. adapter.sh is sourced by gc-check.sh:87, hooks/precommit-gates.sh:76, hooks/plugin-source-gates.sh:243 and inside forge_ledger.py's bash -c. The only code callers of a helper are precommit-gates.sh:119 (afk_build_gate_run) and :162 (afk_build_gate_load); stop-gates.sh is not in the tracked tree.

Each caller resolves its kind in its own process: gc-check loads in its own shell first (gc-check.sh:88); forge_ledger.py starts a fresh bash from a copy of os.environ, so the nested load runs export-shell from its cwd (forge_ledger.py:750-760); precommit-gates.sh loads once at :82 and reads only build-gates; plugin-source-gates.sh calls no function of adapter.sh or config.sh on the runner path.

A kind set as a plain shell variable is read by dispatch in that same shell, set before or after the shell's own load, when the effective configuration names no key for that family; no child process sees it, and a child started with AFK_CFG_LOADED=1 exported and no kind exits 2.

A new caller that hands in a resolved kind in its own shell, exporting neither AFK_CFG_LOADED nor AFK_CONFIG and leaving adapter.sh unedited, changes behaviour for no existing caller: every caller is a separate process that resolves its own kind, and none reads a transport name.

SDD.md:1477 states that no file exports an AFK_CFG_* name; scripts/worktree-provision:60 exports every AFK_CFG_* name, AFK_CFG_LOADED included, to its build-gate children. It sources only config.sh and calls no afk_adapter, so no dispatch caller is affected.
